description:
The Node.js version shows a warning about tmux extended-keys-format when it detects an incompatible setting.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
No such warning appears

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
 Warning: tmux extended-keys-format is xterm. Pi works best with csi-u. Add  to ~/.tmux.conf and restart tmux.

This warning helps users configure their tmux properly for the best experience.
title: TUI-11: Missing warning about tmux extended-keys-format
